title: `typeset -gHi .shadow.depth=0` — zsh 5.9.2 REJECTS a dotted parameter name, zshrs creates it; this is what puts `.shadow.depth`/`.shadow.stack` in zshrs's parameter table after a completion that calls `_shadow`

observed.one_sided: zsh prints NOTHING on stdout and exits 1: the failed `typeset` is fatal in a non-interactive script, so it never reaches the two `print` lines — which is why the rows read `<absent>` rather than `rc=1 present=0`. Its stderr carries `@DIR@/probe.zsh:typeset:2: not valid in this context: .shadow.depth` (one line — it stops there). stderr is not compared in this cell because the two shells prefix diagnostics differently; the exit status and the `present=` counts carry the finding.
observed.notes:
Where this was found: `--session-fuzz` on compsys_parity reports, after `git commit --amen<TAB>`, `added by zshrs only: .shadow.depth, .shadow.stack` and `added by zsh only: mbegin, mend` (plus `___git_resolved_builtins` and `__gitcomp_builtin_commit` from the second repetition on). Replay of that observation, which is NOT what this cell runs — it takes ~4 minutes and two live shells kept alive across episodes:
  scripts/compsys_parity.py --session-replay '{"geom":[24,80],"zstyle":"<repo>/scripts/parity_zstyle.zsh","repeat":2,"episodes":[{"surface":"opt","buffer":"git commit --amen","keys":["tab"],"end":"abort"},{"surface":"opt","buffer":"git commit --amen","keys":["tab"],"end":"abort"}]}' -v
This cell pins the ROOT CAUSE instead, in 0.2s and with no terminal in the picture: the dotted name itself. Round 5 recorded the finding as both shells taking different paths through the same shipped `Completion/Base/Utility/_shadow:36-37`. Measured here, that is not what happens: the `_shadow` first in this host's $fpath is a STUB from a plugin (`_arguments -s -S '*:file:_files'`, nothing to do with upstream's shadow utility) and BOTH shells autoload that same body — verified with `autoload +X -Uz _shadow; functions _shadow`. zsh could not create those names even if it did reach upstream's file: the restriction is live in upstream's own source at Src/builtin.c:2546 (`not valid in this context`) as of 599af4604f, the tree tests/ztst_compsys/ uses as its oracle. What is NOT explained here is the other half of the session-fuzz observation — the `mbegin`/`mend` that zsh leaves behind and zshrs does not; that is pinned as observed, not root-caused.

controls.note: the same declaration with the dots removed. PASS — `typeset -gHi` is not the variable, the NAME is

variants.note: reached the way a completion reaches it, through _shadow rather than through a bare typeset: zsh `depth=0 stack=0`, zshrs `depth=1 stack=1`
